name: Claims Action
description: Raised by flow 9 (claim-intake) whenever a claim is notified. Work the claim record — verify claimant details, the incident description and the estimated loss, and progress claim_status. This task does not carry the `referral` tag, so flow 11 ignores any status move made on it.

_notes.priority_and_tag: Both copied verbatim from contract artefact 4: priority `highest` (spec §4.7.2 'urgent') and tag `claim`, both written by flow 9 on this task kind.
_notes.no_referral_tag: Same load-bearing exclusion as the Sanctions Compliance Review template — no `referral` tag means flow 11 never acts on this task regardless of what status it is moved to.
_notes.form_action: Pinned to claim_config with no named view — claim_config has only a `table` view today, verified by reading record_configs/claim_config.json (not edited). claim_config also needs the `uploader` input type for its `documents` field (plan §6.1), which is wave 2/2b's concern, not this template's.
_notes.assignees: Deliberately left unset — see the Underwriting Review template's note; no real claims-user id exists on this staging account to hardcode.
